about: Draws the destinations a page is reached from: rows one under another, and branches that open onto rows of their own.

corners.about: Every corner, on the row naming the page being read.
corners.title: Corners

highlights.about: Every highlight at every size, drawn on the row carrying `aria-current`.
highlights.title: Highlights and sizes

iconic.about: The list as it is, and collapsed to a rail: the rows become squares, the counts and the chevrons go, and the words stay in the document for a screen reader.
iconic.title: Iconic

looks.about: A list of rows, and a dock of destinations across the foot of a screen.
looks.title: Looks

reveal.about: An action always drawn, and one that appears with the pointer and stays under a coarse pointer or while the row holds focus.
reveal.title: Reveal

title: Nav list
